Blockburg Classic

NEW! RED VS BLUE!

Two teams, two flags! Grab the other team's flag and run it back to your base. Trowel walls and paintballs only. Bring friends from the Multiplayer page!

Blockburg News

RED VS BLUE is here! Grab the other team's flag and run it back to your base. First to 3 captures wins. Warning: the Guests are scary good at guarding. Play it from the front page!

Start your engines! Three cars are waiting at the Race Track in Blockburg Classic. Please do not run over Guest 31. He has been through enough.

Badge hunting season! 12 badges to collect, from Obby Champ to Night Owl. Hover a faded one under My Badges to see how to get it.

Halloween special! Wear the whole Pumpkin King set from the bottom of the Catalog and you'll shimmer. Guest 31 says AAAAAAAAAAAA. We think that means "nice outfit". Gone October 31st!!

Building contest, round 2! Make something with script blocks (a secret door, a trap, a launch pad...) and send it with Post to Games. Prize: still bragging rights.

Remember: never tell anyone your password, even if they say they're a Builder. Real admins never need it.

Build

Want to make your own place? Start on an empty baseplate. Open Insert in-game for bricks and BrickColors, use the Grab, Clone, Delete and Paint tools, then Save your place. Save it when you leave and it shows up below as a file you can open again.

Proud of it? Press Post to Games in the Insert window. The admin checks every project first, and you'll get a message in your Inbox.

How it works

Same game file: everyone needs the same copy of Blockburg (easiest: put it online and share the link).

The host runs the world. If the host leaves, the game ends for everyone.

Up to 8 players. Works best on home internet; some school or work networks block it.

Your look (hat, shirt, pants, face, colors) comes with you.
